rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the body part in people and animals.

example.english: My neck has been hurting all day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 geng2 tung3 zo2 seng4 jat6

rows.note: Use 領 for the collar or neckband of a shirt, dress, or similar garment.

example.english: The neck of this shirt is too tight.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 seot1 saam1 go3 ling5 taai3 gan2 laa3

rows.note: Use 樽頸 specifically for the narrowed neck of a bottle.

example.english: This bottle's neck is so narrow that pouring is slow.
example.traditional: 呢個樽頸咁窄，倒水好慢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zeon1 geng2 gam3 zaak3 dou2 seoi2 hou2 maan6
